blocks.content: We, the people of India, having solemnly resolved to constitute India into a Sovereign Democratic Republic, do hereby adopt, enact and give to ourselves this Constitution on twenty-sixth day of November, 1949.

rows: Indirectly elected by members of Provincial Legislative Assemblies
Nominated by the heads of the Princely States
Elected representatives divided among Muslims, Sikhs, and General categories

items: M.N. Roy proposed the idea of Constituent Assembly in 1934; the Indian National Congress officially demanded it in 1935.
The Objectives Resolution introduced by Nehru formed the basis of the Preamble of the Indian Constitution.
Sir B.N. Rau was appointed as the Constitutional Advisor (Legal Advisor) to the Constituent Assembly.
January 26 was chosen as the date of commencement to commemorate the 'Poorna Swaraj' day celebrated in 1930.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The idea of a Constituent Assembly for India was first put forward by M.N. Roy in 1934.
The Constituent Assembly was constituted in November 1946 under the scheme formulated by the Cabinet Mission Plan.
Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha was elected as the temporary President, while Dr. Rajendra Prasad was later elected as the President.
Jawaharlal Nehru moved the historic Objectives Resolution on December 13, 1946, which shaped the philosophical foundation of the Constitution.
The Drafting Committee, chaired by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, was set up on August 29, 1947, to prepare the draft Constitution.
